subject: Oceanography
title: Ocean Trenches
description: A fast breakdown of Ocean Trenches for builders.

hook.text: The Mariana Trench is so deep that sound takes 7 seconds to travel from the surface to the bottom.

buildup.text: Ocean trenches are the deepest features on Earth—long, narrow cracks in the seafloor.

discovery.text: They mark subduction zones where oceanic crust plunges into the mantle at speeds of 2–10 cm/year.

twist.text: Trenches are geologically young—no trench sediment is older than about 200 million years.

climax.text: Life exists even at the deepest points—amphipods, bacteria, and xenophyophores thrive there.

punchline.text: Where the seafloor dies, life still finds a way.

quiz.question: What geological process creates ocean trenches?
